QUOTE: When that flag is on and no std functions are configured, the default is `platform_calloc_uninit` (returns NULL) and a no-op free (`platform.c:25-42`). So an unconfigured bare-metal build fails allocations cleanly instead of failing to link.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the uninitialised default calloc returns NULL and the default free is a no-op, i.e. the defaults fail rather than fall back.
